The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Montross (bounty hunter)|Montross]] hunted and killed a wanted [[Unidentified human (Montross)|human man]] in a rocky [[Desert/Legends|desert]] with steep cliffs on an '''unidentified world'''. The world orbited at least one sun. Although it contained at least one desert, the world was seen to be blue from orbit, indicating that it was largely covered by [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The world appeared in the game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', in a cutscene where Montross kills the man then leaves in his ship.<ref name="BH" />
